s.g: (biblical) any of four books of the Old Testament and Apocrypha of the Bible.

Describing the chemical composition or temperature of a mixture of substances that gives the lowest temperature at which the mixture becomes fully molten. A further requirement is that that temperature is lower than the melting point of any of the pure component substances.
A material that has the composition of a eutectic mixture or eutectic alloy.
A fish of the order Pleuronectiformes, the adults of which have both eyes on one side and usually swim with the other side down, such as a flounder, a halibut, or a sole.
(anatomy) A curve or bend in a tubular organ.
A person who sells, makes, repairs, alters, cleans, or otherwise deals in pelts or in clothing made of fur.
The scientific forecasting of future trends in science, technology or society
(Internet slang, vulgar) Initialism of go fuck yourself.
(anatomy) The space between the eyebrows and above the nose.
An area of undeveloped landscape, such as parkland left within a city during planning and zoning other areas for development.
Fruit of these plants.
A plate with rows of pointed needles used to blend or straighten hair. [from 20th c.]
A cart designed to be pulled or pushed by hand (as opposed to with a beast of burden.)
Any of various simple vascular plants, of the order Equisetales, that have hollow stems and produce spores.
In an idiotic manner.
An old, dilapidated or unpretentious automobile.
(India) An infantryman; a soldier.
A language closely related to Finnish, spoken in Karelia, Russia and Finland.
The movement of an organism in response to an external stimulus.
A subset of the rare-earth elements
(ecology) The science concerning the biological, physical and geological properties of fresh water bodies, especially lakes and ponds.
(uncountable) The act of mispronouncing.
(Christianity) A prayer said or sung as an anthem while offerings of bread and wine are placed on the altar during the Roman Catholic Mass or the Anglican Communion service. [from 14th c.]
Any of various substances added to a material (such as plastic or concrete) in order to make it more pliable.
A state of being uncertain or unstable.
Modifying a noun from within a predicate.
A feeling of apprehension, doubt, fear etc. [from 16th c.]
synonym of kidney-shaped — see also kidney-shaped
A foam created by the agitation of seawater.
(anime, manga) A style of anime and manga intended for young women.
A dockworker involved in loading and unloading cargo, or in supervising such work. [from 18th c.]
One who tattles (reports others' wrongdoings), often a child seeking attention.
The very topmost point.
To walk unsteadily, as a small child does.
An infectious disease of the eyelid caused by the bacterium Chlamydia trachomatis.

A large vertebrate skeletal muscle divided into an ascending, descending, and transverse portion, attaching the neck and central spine to the outer extremity of the scapula; it functions in scapular elevation, adduction, and depression.
A foot-operated pedal or lever that generates motion.
One who upholsters furniture, especially a trained craftsman who does so as an occupation.
(uncountable) The state of being honest, honourable, and moral.
A percussion instrument with a double row of tuned metal bars, each above a tubular resonator containing a motor-driven rotating vane, giving a vibrato effect.
A rodent of the genus Dasyprocta, similar in appearance to a guinea pig but having longer legs, mainly native to Central and South America.
(colloquial) Thank you (used in the context of, or to evoke, Japanese culture).

The ancient name of the country between the range of the Hindu Kush and the Amu Darya in West Asia, encompassing parts of northern Afghanistan, eastern Turkmenistan, southern Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and northern Pakistan.
(baseball, softball) A player who is on base and is thus trying to advance to the next base.
A thin pole for supporting bean vines.
(of a gift, etc.) Liberal or abundant.
(, of a person) Inclined to be generous.
A fresh southern Italian cheese similar to creamy mozzarella.
A public survey of land, originally for the purpose of taxation and to create an official register of land ownership.
A synthetic or recombinant form of calcitonin used to treat Paget disease of bone and postmenopausal osteoporosis.

Any tree of the genus Catalpa, in the family Bignoniaceae. The two North American species, the southern catalpa, Catalpa bignonioides, and the northern catalpa, Catalpa speciosa — along with the yellow catalpa, Catalpa ovata, from China — are often planted as ornamentals because of their showy flowers and decorative bean pods, though others regard the bean pods as a nuisance.

(constellation) A spring constellation of the northern sky (and autumn of the southern sky) with the outline of a centaur. It includes the stars Alpha Centauri (Rigil Kentaurus and Toliman), Proxima Centauri, and Hadar.
A person, usually male, who holds reactionary political views.
(UK, Commonwealth, Ireland, slang) Vomit. [from 1950.]
(Australia, New Zealand, Britain, slang) To throw up, to vomit, particularly from excessive alcohol consumption.
The state of being physically clean and free of contamination or dirt; cleanliness.
A morpheme that functions like a word, but never appears as an independent word, instead being always attached to a following or preceding word (or, in some cases, within a surrounding word).
A syrupy solution of nitrocellulose (pyroxylin) in alcohol and ether that evaporates on a surface to form a clear elastic film; used in surgical dressings, photographic plates and lacquer paints.
Any of several species of perennial herbs of the genus Symphytum, often specifically common comfrey (Symphytum officinale).
The removal of the myelin sheath from a nerve fibre, usually as a result of disease causing myelinolysis.
(transitive) To express disapproval of, protest or plead against.
(Australia) A padded blanket used as a cover in bed; a duvet.
